title: WT contralateral biol rep 1 3h
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was isolated from homogenized mouse brain using Allprep DNA/RNA/Protein kit  (Qiagen) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. RNA quality and concentration were measured using a RNA Pico chip on an Agilent Bioanalyzer.
extract_protocol_ch1.1: RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina protocols
data_processing: Sequence reads were trimmed with TrimGalore, in single-end mode, clipping 10 bases at the 5’ of each read to remove sequencing bias, and filtering out all low-quality bases from reads (<30 Phred score).
data_processing.1: Trimmed sequence reads were mapped to GRCm39/mm39 using HISAT2, with --dta in additional to default parameters.
data_processing.2: Aligned sequence reads were sorted by coordinates and indexed using samtools.
data_processing.3: Indexed sequence reads were annotated using featureCounts.
data_processing.4: Read count normalization was performed with DESeq2.
data_processing.6: Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text file includes normalized counts for each Sample (normalization by median of ratios method).
contact_department: Department of Clinical and Molecular Medicine (IKOM)
contact_institute: Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences,NTNU
